scope.basis: 818e86c plus reviewed direct-IR linker delta; precise source hashes captured at run start
scope.order: Rotating syntax/implementation order within each whole application; fresh Node process for every cell; no simultaneous builds/tests/timings; load1 must be at most10.
scope.scope: Dependency-graph loading and validation plus optimized C emission for six whole real programs. Inputs are preloaded source maps, filesystem root/symlink checks occur in measured linking; process initialization/input-map loading outside pipeline but included in wall/RSS. Same public checker/optimizer/backend for all arms. New-flat remains a private frozen-grammar parser prototype. No native C compilation or model billing in these timings. Exact IR and identical C bytes required before timing. No final migration or all-platform frontend claim.

limitations: Research harness, same public checker/optimizer/backend across arms; not a completed single-source frontend.
Peak RSS includes common preloaded research modules and input/output accounting, not just the compiler.
No inferred runtime speedup from byte-identical emitted artifacts. Losses and earlier measurements are retained.
